title: Latent circuit inference from heterogeneous neural responses during cognitive tasks
counting_unit: One paper-result family. Reproduction, improvement, code-access conditions, animals, folds and individual output checks add no independent benchmark registrations.

paper.rights: Article XML declares CC-BY-4.0; third-party exceptions remain.

scientific_question: Can an agent reproduce the complete two-monkey empirical latent-circuit result and improve neural prediction without choosing a trivially easier projection or sacrificing behavior?
complete_scientific_unit: All released Mante2013 PFC neurons and trials needed for the empirical Figure6/ExtendedData9 result in both monkeys A and F. The200 trained-RNN simulation study is a separate part of the paper and is not claimed reproduced by this empirical unit.

published_anchors.metric: test R-squared in fitted latent projection
published_anchors.meaning: These are fits in the learned task subspace, not variance explained across the full recorded population.

published_anchors.metric: fraction of total PFC variance represented by learned task subspace

published_anchors.units: 36 stimulus conditions per context; not36 animals

candidate_conditions.name: paper_and_data
candidate_conditions.reproduction_exposure: Paper, complete authentic inputs for the declared reproduction endpoint, common schema and output interface. Full reproduction inputs may contain outcomes later reserved for improvement; this packet is not a protected-improvement packet. No official analysis source or fitted reference parameters.
candidate_conditions.improvement_exposure: Paper, development inputs/labels and only explicitly permitted past calibration material, plus a common schema and output interface. Outer assessment targets, forbidden future signal and future annotations remain with the owner; full-data reproduction material is absent.

candidate_conditions.name: paper_data_official_code
candidate_conditions.reproduction_exposure: Identical reproduction packet plus the selected official analysis source and declared dependencies. Owner reference caches and fitted answer-parameter artifacts are excluded.
candidate_conditions.improvement_exposure: Identical protected improvement packet plus the selected official analysis source and declared dependencies, audited to exclude fitted answer parameters, held outcomes and reference caches. A reproduction run or its artifacts are not supplied.

evaluation_owner: Reference construction and private target generation stay outside every candidate context. Reproduction and protected improvement use distinct authoring packets/workspaces/contexts as specified by phase_and_context_isolation. Frozen improvement programs are assessed in fresh offline containers with owner-only targets/reference caches. No model or native run is selected.
contamination: Public papers, data and code may already occur in model training. Paper reproduction is an execution/reasoning test with known published anchors, not a claim of unseen scientific discovery. Prospective splits, hidden labels, code-access parity and frozen-program evaluation are required for improvement.

required_outputs: Complete unit/trial/condition eligibility ledger for both monkeys, retaining excluded units with original reasons.
Both72-condition train/test trajectory tensors and all preprocessing identities.
Both200-start fitting ensembles, fixed model-selection criteria, selected top-ten connectivity summaries and embedding identities.
Projected test R-squared, fraction of full variance captured, task fit and all four irrelevant-stimulus suppression statistics.
No-recurrence comparator for both monkeys; error-trial analysis reported separately with all available conditions and explicit denominator.
reproduction.original_method: At least four correct trials per unit in each of72 stimulus conditions; disjoint half-trial split;50ms firing-rate bins,40ms Gaussian smoothing, within-split z-scoring and condition-independent mean subtraction; PCA retaining50% variance; latent circuit alpha.2, recurrent noise.15, modified three-term PFC loss with lambda.5;200 model initializations per monkey.
reproduction.unit_discrepancy: Results name727/574 PFC units; Methods name762/640 available units and483/323 meeting the>=4-correct-trials-per-condition criterion. These populations must be reconciled against source/data rather than selecting the numbers that fit. Full-trial eligibility is unverified.
reproduction.source_gap: Pinned latent_net.py implements mse_z + l_y*nmse_y and has no fitted intercept or the paper-specific three-term PFC objective. The release tree and README expose a trained-RNN tutorial, not a demonstrated complete empirical-PFC entry point. Recover or faithfully specify the missing empirical procedure before claiming an official-reference run.
reproduction.stochastic_matching: Use declared seed manifests and compare the whole distribution of retained fits and numerical anchors within predeclared MonteCarlo/tolerance intervals. Do not tune seeds or tolerances until the published values appear.
reproduction.limits: Original half-trial/PCA/z-scoring choices are reproduction semantics; they are not automatically acceptable prospective preprocessing. Published parameters are owner-side reference aids, not candidate code-access material.

published_descriptions: Experimental stimulus follows the context cue by650ms and lasts750ms.

Neural data are described as750ms starting100ms after stimulus onset;50ms windows/steps are described, with the first window centered100ms after onset and the last100ms after stimulus offset. The paper also refers to15 available neural time steps.
The model is described as150 steps of10ms from context onset to1500ms, with context input throughout0–1500ms and stimulus input750–1500ms.
Methods says neural-response fitting uses the last15 model time steps for which PFC data are available, and task-output error is penalized only during the last250ms.
required_resolution: Authenticate the exact neural sample-center/end-point convention and all preprocessing support.
Identify the model-to-neural sampling/resampling adapter, context/stimulus schedules, initial state and physical-time correspondence.
Join the exact neural-fit and task-readout/loss windows to the recovered empirical code before a native reference is declared.
native_clock_gate.rule: Retain all published descriptions. Do not silently choose an alignment that makes fitting convenient or declare a paper error from this unresolved source-level ambiguity.
native_clock_gate.source_gap: The inspected released class does not provide the complete empirical sampling/timing adapter.

improvement.proposed_primary: Predict held-trial neural trajectories in a fixed original-neuron coordinate system; score normalized squared prediction error using training-defined scaling. Report each monkey and their equal-weight mean. Candidate-dependent projected R-squared is diagnostic only.
improvement.split: Predeclare nested disjoint trial splits per unit and stimulus condition. Fit all centering, scaling, denoising/PCA and hyperparameters on development trials; an outer frozen trial set is only accessed by the owner scorer. Preserve all original eligible units and72 conditions. Because units need not be simultaneously recorded, do not invent synchronized single-trial population vectors.
baselines: Original reconstructed latent circuit with equal optimization budget
Fixed low-rank linear dynamics or reduced-rank predictor

behavior_guard.primary_guard: Predeclare the exact native continuous task-output loss, its normalization and scoring time window after recovering the empirical reference. The paper describes two targets taking1.2 and0.2 according to choice and penalizing task-output error in the last250ms; verify exact implementation before freezing the guard.
behavior_guard.choice_metric: Binary choice accuracy may be reported as a separately defined metric with an explicit decision rule and time point. It is not interchangeable with continuous task-output loss or task-fit R-squared.
behavior_guard.non_inferiority: Compare against the same native reference under identical protected folds and optimization budget. No non-inferiority threshold, tolerance or calibration is currently validated; predeclare it using development evidence before viewing outer outcomes.
behavior_guard.separation: Report neural prediction loss, native task-output loss and any separately defined choice metric separately. Neither projected neural R-squared nor task-fit R-squared is presented as choice accuracy.

improvement.scientific_extension: Test whether model-derived suppression predicts error-condition activity and whether conclusions survive fixed-coordinate evaluation and condition-blocked validation. Model connectivity is an inferred mechanism, not an anatomical or interventional finding.
improvement.uncertainty: Only two biological animals. Report per-monkey paired differences and conditional trial/session uncertainty; neither random initializations nor72 conditions justify population-level n=400 or n=144. Session hierarchy and trial independence must be established before resampling.

resource_estimate.planning_hardware: PyTorch CPU is supported by inspected class defaults; a GPU may accelerate fitting. A provisional16GiB RAM planning target is not a measured requirement.
resource_estimate.wall_time: Unknown until exact empirical entry point, dimensions and stopping rules are recovered. No claimed hours or cost.

phase_and_context_isolation.reproduction: Use a distinct reproduction workspace, packet and authoring context. This explicitly known-answer reconstruction condition may expose the complete reproduction dataset.
phase_and_context_isolation.improvement: Start a fresh independent authoring context and workspace for each improvement code-access condition and replicate. It receives only the improvement packet. No reproduction transcript, full-data file, reference result, fitted weights, source-derived answer cache, prior session state or adapted candidate program transfers into this context.
phase_and_context_isolation.cross_condition: The paper-and-data context must not inherit source/code/output seen by the paper-data-code context. Common supplied scientific assistance is fixed independently and declared for both.
phase_and_context_isolation.assessment: Freeze the improvement program before outer assessment. Only the owner creates assessment inputs under the declared protocol; sealed labels and forbidden future signals/annotations are not mounted or exposed through tools, logs, filenames or returned scores. Permitted calibration is fixed in advance and is not a channel for full-data reproduction results.
phase_and_context_isolation.intentional_transfer: A deliberately reused/exposed context is a separately labeled transfer/contaminated condition. Its score must not be described as protected improvement and it does not create another benchmark registration.
phase_and_context_isolation.limits: Fresh local context prevents the specific cross-phase transfer above; it does not prove absence of public paper/data memorization from pretraining or other prior exposure. Public-data contamination remains acknowledged.
